# Pulumi (Go Programs and Library)

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/pulumi.md`.

- PULUMI-01 must: Structure a program as a thin `main.go` plus `pkg/{lib,model,util}`: `lib` creates resources, `model` holds config structs, `util` holds helpers; test doubles live in `test/mocks`.
  Good: `main.go` only loads config and calls `lib.Create(ctx, cfg)`; structs sit in `pkg/model`.
  Bad: a 400-line `main.go` that declares resources and config structs.
- PULUMI-02 must: In Pulumi programs, log the failure with the area prefix, then return the error unchanged; do not wrap with `%w` at each level. Libraries, including shared-library, wrap new errors (GO-12).
  Good: `log.Err(err).Msgf("[google][project] error creating project: %s", name)` then `return err`
- PULUMI-03 must: Name error variables after the call with a short operation prefix and `Err` (`sErr`, `iErr`, `ghErr`); reuse plain `err` only for the first error in a function. [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `sErr := secret.Create(...)` then `iErr := ingress.Create(...)`.
  Bad: `err := secret.Create(...)` then `err := ingress.Create(...)` in the same function.
- PULUMI-04 prefer: In Pulumi programs (libraries wrap errors per GO-12 instead), prefix log messages as `[area][sub-area]` and word them "error `<doing>` ..." or "failed to `<do>` ...".
- PULUMI-05 must: Load stack configuration once in a `config` package into typed model structs with `cfg.RequireObject`, or with `cfg.GetObject` only when the whole config key is optional and a missing key means all defaults; make optional fields pointers and read them with `defaults.GetOrDefault(ptr, fallback)`.
  Good: `var c model.Vault; cfg.RequireObject("vault", &c)` and `defaults.GetOrDefault(c.Replicas, 3)`; `cfg.GetObject("server", &c)` when the whole `server` key may be absent.
  Bad: `cfg.Get("replicas")` parsed with `strconv.Atoi` inside a resource function.
- PULUMI-06 prefer: In the reusable library, create resources with `Create(ctx, opts)` or `Create(ctx, name, opts)` (24 of 43 take `name`): context first, options struct last; export the options struct, document every field, make optional fields pointers or documented defaults, and add extras through `PulumiOptions []pulumi.ResourceOption`. Repo-internal helpers keep positional arguments.
- PULUMI-07 prefer: Test resources with `pulumi.RunErr` and `pulumi.WithMocks`, assert resource counts by type token or resource outputs, and keep mocks in `test/mocks`.
- PULUMI-08 lean: Gate destructive operator toggles behind an environment variable that defaults to false.
